attributes.title: Nightshift investigations
attributes.description: Investigations grouped by severity, with the conversation of each a click away and a Create case action.

hero.query: FROM nightshift-app-investigations | STATS active = COUNT(*) WHERE in_progress == true | EVAL headline = CASE(active > 0, "Investigations are underway", "You're all caught up")

counts.query: FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | STATS in_progress = COUNT(*) WHERE in_progress == true, critical = COUNT(*) WHERE severity == "critical" AND in_progress == false, high = COUNT(*) WHERE severity == "high" AND in_progress == false, medium = COUNT(*) WHERE severity == "medium" AND in_progress == false, low = COUNT(*) WHERE severity == "low" AND in_progress == false, not_rated = COUNT(*) WHERE severity IS NULL AND in_progress == false

children.title: Critical
children.query: FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE severity == "critical" AND (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | STATS investigations = COUNT(*)

FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE in_progress == true AND (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | KEEP id, created_at, title, summary, entities, severity, in_progress, agent_id | SORT created_at DESC | LIMIT 100

FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE severity == "critical" AND in_progress == false AND (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | KEEP id, created_at, title, summary, entities, severity, in_progress, agent_id | SORT created_at DESC | LIMIT 100

FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE severity == "high" AND in_progress == false AND (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | KEEP id, created_at, title, summary, entities, severity, in_progress, agent_id | SORT created_at DESC | LIMIT 100

FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE severity == "medium" AND in_progress == false AND (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | KEEP id, created_at, title, summary, entities, severity, in_progress, agent_id | SORT created_at DESC | LIMIT 100

FROM nightshift-app-investigations | WHERE severity IS NULL AND in_progress == false AND (?q == "" OR TO_LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*") OR TO_LOWER(summary) LIKE CONCAT("*", TO_LOWER(?q), "*")) | KEEP id, created_at, title, summary, entities, severity, in_progress, agent_id | SORT created_at DESC | LIMIT 100
